name: relink
description: Weave a new node (concept, framework, theory, project, principle) into the whole vault graph rather than just creating a note. Mode A links one new node against the vault by top-K retrieval, with the LLM judging only those candidates; mode --deep finds orphaned islands and wires them in. Backup before edits, preview before writing. Triggers: "/relink", "integrate this concept".
